Part of our Unisex collection, it comes in an array of lengths for riders of all sizes.

citation.reasoning: Official manufacturer product page — the primary authoritative source for specifications, pricing, and product details. Full spec table with all sizes, features, and construction details extracted from page.

quotelist.quote: Low Pressure Studio B.V. is responsible for this Page

citation.reasoning: Official Bataleon Facebook page identifies Low Pressure Studio B.V. as the entity responsible for the brand.

quotelist.quote: The Nidecker Group is home to the most innovative and inspirational board sports and lifestyle brands: Bataleon, Emerica, éS, Etnies, Jones, Nidecker, Rome, Thirtytwo and #YES.

citation.reasoning: Official Nidecker Group website confirms Bataleon as part of their brand portfolio and lists all sister brands. This is the parent company's own site.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon founder Jorgen Karlsen doesn't snowboard. Instead, he is fascinated by the forces at work on boards.

citation.reasoning: ISPO is a major sports trade fair organization. This article provides credible background on Bataleon's founder as a Norwegian biophysicist. Published by a reputable industry source.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon Snowboards was established by Norwegian Jorgen Karlson in 2000, when he invented the now famous Triple Base Technology - 3BT.

citation.reasoning: Onboard Magazine is a reputable snowboard publication. States founding year as 2000, consistent with multiple other sources.

quotelist.quote: Since making their way onto the snowboard scene back in 1998, Bataleon have really pushed the boundaries of snowboard technology innovation.

citation.reasoning: A third-party retailer blog states 1998 as founding year. This conflicts with the more widely cited 2000. Lower credibility for exact dates since it's a shop blog, not primary source.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon board's are designed at the Low Pressure Studio in Amsterdam.

citation.reasoning: Well-researched article on snowboard manufacturing locations, provides specific detail about Bataleon's design headquarters in Amsterdam.

quotelist.quote: All Bataleon boards are hand-built in Austria at the Mothership with focus on craftsmanship and exceptional materials.

citation.reasoning: Whitelines is a well-established snowboard magazine. Confirms Austrian manufacturing at the CAPiTA Mothership.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon snowboards are now manufactured in Austria. They now use the CAPiTA Mothership.

citation.reasoning: Blog about snowboard manufacturing that confirms CAPiTA Mothership as current production location. Consistent with other sources.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon used to have their boards produced at the Elan factory in Austria but when that closed they had to move production.

citation.reasoning: Provides manufacturing history including moves between factories. Multiple data points about production location changes.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon makes the final of the competition at the same time they enter the market in winter 2004/05.

citation.reasoning: ISPO's own article about Bataleon's brand launch at their trade fair, documenting market entry timing.

The ThunderStorm is a cross between the Bataleon men's Thunder Snowboard and the women's Storm Snowboard.

citation.reasoning: Evo's field-tested review confirms the ThunderStorm's debut season and its origin as a combination of the Thunder and Storm models. Evo is a major, reputable retailer.

quotelist.quote: In this review, I will take a look at the Thunderstorm as a mellow freeride snowboard.

citation.reasoning: Independent reviewer categorizes the ThunderStorm as a "mellow freeride" board. Reviewer has extensive testing experience across 300+ models.
